--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8a80
+title: 'ShardCheck: teacher-force reference tokens and tie-aware argmax gate'
+---
+Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4 "failed" the shard check on the default prompt because of a near-exact tie: top-2 logits of 6.59375 vs 6.5625 (one bf16 step apart, KL 0.0003). Sharding flipped the winner, and every later step then compared different contexts (KL 1.8). That isn't a sharding defect (zyx7p8z bisect). Make the check robust:
+- [ ] **Teacher forcing:** the sharded run feeds the reference run's greedy tokens (from the reference .json) instead of its own argmax, so one flipped tie can't cascade. Per-step KL then compares the same contexts.
+- [ ] **Tie-aware argmax gate:** an argmax mismatch fails only when the reference margin (top1 − top2 logit) is above a small epsilon, e.g. 2 bf16 ulps at that magnitude or 0.05 logits. Print ties as "tie, skipped".
+- [ ] **Default prompt:** switch to real English token ids (pre-tokenized per model family, or have ShardCheck accept text and use the model's tokenizer if one is available), so made-up ids don't invite ties.
+- [ ] Re-run Qwen3.8-27B-4bit/mxfp4 and Inkling 4bit/oQ4e-mtp; all must pass with the gate unchanged (KL ≤ 0.05). #cluster
\ No newline at end of file

--- original

@@ -48,7 +48,7 @@
 title: 'ShardCheck: teacher-force reference tokens and tie-aware argmax gate'
 ---
 Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4 "failed" the shard check on the default prompt because of a near-exact tie: top-2 logits of 6.59375 vs 6.5625 (one bf16 step apart, KL 0.0003). Sharding flipped the winner, and every later step then compared different contexts (KL 1.8). That isn't a sharding defect (zyx7p8z bisect). Make the check robust:
-- [ ] **Teacher forcing:** the sharded run feeds the reference run's greedy tokens (from the reference .json) instead of its own argmax, so one flipped tie can't cascade. Per-step KL then compares the same contexts.
-- [ ] **Tie-aware argmax gate:** an argmax mismatch fails only when the reference margin (top1 − top2 logit) is above a small epsilon, e.g. 2 bf16 ulps at that magnitude or 0.05 logits. Print ties as "tie, skipped".
-- [ ] **Default prompt:** switch to real English token ids (pre-tokenized per model family, or have ShardCheck accept text and use the model's tokenizer if one is available), so made-up ids don't invite ties.
-- [ ] Re-run Qwen3.8-27B-4bit/mxfp4 and Inkling 4bit/oQ4e-mtp; all must pass with the gate unchanged (KL ≤ 0.05). #cluster
